name: Abu Nuwas
bio: Abu Nuwas was born in Ahwaz, grew up in Basra and joined the circle of the Abbasid caliphs in Baghdad. Known for poems about wine, he also wrote hunting verse and praise, including poems for al-Khasib in Egypt and al-Amin in Baghdad. Al-Zirikli quotes al-Jahiz as saying he had never met anyone with a greater knowledge of Arabic, a learning Abu Nuwas brought to the new subjects of city life. He died in Baghdad. Al-Zirikli gives 198 AH (814 CE) and records other proposed dates.
